about_short_description.short_description: Creizer provides financing for online regional sellers through customized payments based on their sales,

product.name: Crédito Inteligente
product.description: A financing option for online sellers that adjusts repayment based on daily sales, with no fixed payments or interest rates.

product.name: Programa de Referidos (Referral Program)
product.description: A program where users can earn money by referring other sellers to Creizer, who then obtain a credit.

product.name: Programa de Partners (Partners Program)
product.description: A partnership program that allows businesses to earn additional income by referring clients to Creizer for financing solutions.
